objective_requirements.finding: Twelve naturalized transfer conversations contain 24 messages each and cover pressure, stand-down, and park strata; source hashes and manifests were frozen before transfer.

Transcript-only, direct-pressure, and graph-expanded packets, deterministic ledgers, bounds, provenance, strict schemas, and apply/reject/park compilation are implemented and locally validated. Calibration exercised all arms; transfer pressure arms did not activate.

The transfer runtime froze model, provider, prompts, schemas, graph policy, seeds, call limits, and source inputs. Repeat and cold-reader contracts are frozen. The exact comparative review contract was frozen after T1 began, so T1 cannot support a clean prospectively blinded causal claim.

Calibration completed and all twelve untouched transfer cases were attempted with no between-case tuning, retry, fallback, or healing. Seven completed, one failed its semantic role join, and four preserved HTTP 402 funding-envelope failures.

Usefulness, restraint, attribution, integrity, stability, operability, and receipt reconstruction were assessed separately. Unknown or unmeasured dimensions remain explicit rather than being collapsed into a score.

The final reassessment closes the V1 evidence program without claiming product reliability, records constitutional fit and drift, prohibits routine Gemini 3.5 testing, and chooses a provider-free constitutional audit before any bounded cheap consumer call.

evaluation_dimensions.finding: Calibration contains one useful synthetic pressure example, but transfer produced no pressure-bearing arm and transcript-only outputs mostly restated the source. Genuine user usefulness remains unknown.
Five of seven completed transfer cases correctly stood down; two falsely stood down because relevant residual challenges were absent from the representation.
Direct and graph custody is exact, but no untouched transfer case exposed graph marginal value. Calibration cannot support a clean product attribution claim.
All twelve receipts pass source, contract, call-artifact, usage, failure, and self-containment integrity checks, including preserved failures.
The prospective cross-stratum repeat subset was omitted from V14 and the later repair contract was not run. Calibration variance is diagnostic, not a clean stability measurement.

Across premium calibration and transfer, 87 of 96 attempted calls were operationally okay at $3.1495905. Transfer completed 7 of 12 cases. Affordable decomposed microtasks later used 50 calls and $0.076058862, but no production operator was selected.

Every attempted case has a self-contained receipt, but no fresh agent or human executed the frozen V1 reconstruction contract. Receipt custody must not be described as comprehension or proof of reasoning quality.
